_meta.authoritative_note: Confirmed authoritative by Jules 2026-09-04. Other 2026 budget workbooks exist in SharePoint (Marketing Hand Off/Budgets & Reports, and copies under retired-user folders); they are superseded and must not be reconciled against.
_meta.basis: Approved annual marketing budget by GL account by month. Budget is NOT loaded into NetSuite - Budget vs. Actual (report -197) returns Budget Amount 0 for every account and at the subsidiary grand-total line. This file is the only budget source.

66212.0002.note: Agency fees are 20% of combined Google + Meta spend, per cells B5:M5 of the source workbook. This is not a fixed line: any increase in Google or Meta spend carries a 20% agency surcharge. Every budget ask involving paid media must be priced with it.

cancellations.reason: World of Concrete trade show cancelled
cancellations.note: Approved but will not be executed. Jan and Apr postings ($24,958.25 combined) had already been spent before the cancellation. Budget-vs-actual must show these months as released, not as underspend - an unspent line the business cancelled is a different fact from an unspent line it failed to execute.

66212.0020.name: Advertising & Marketing : Advertising
66212.0020.note: Zero budget, but carries $25,879.27 of Jan-Mar actuals. Evidence indicates this is Google spend posted before the account split: 66212.0016 has zero actual in Jan-Mar, 66212.0020 has zero actual from Apr onward, and March's 0020 posting of $8,466.00 equals the March Google budget of $8,466.00 exactly. Treated as Google for channel reporting via reclass_to. INFERENCE - accounting has not yet confirmed.

unbudgeted_actuals.note: Accounts carrying 2026 actuals with no approved budget line. Every dollar must still appear in the budget-vs-actual table; these become explicit rows rather than being dropped, which is how v1's table under-reported.

targets.note: The approved budget workbook carries GL spend only - no revenue or new-customer target. Until these are supplied, 'Are we spending wisely?' can report budget-vs-actual and year-over-year, but cannot report performance against plan.
